items.title: Chico Hamilton interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 30, 2000
items.q: Jack happens to be my oldest, dearest, best friend. ... we’ve known each other since we were eight years old.

ctx.x: Jack Kelson said he had a couple of little interesting anecdotes or remembrances of those times, and he said something about in grammar school where a band person would go around and everybody would get to play something. And when it got to you you’d like wipe everybody out. Is that true?

Jack happens to be my oldest, dearest, best friend. And you know what? I just talked to him the other day. We have never had a cross word, and we’ve known each other since we were eight years old. Yeah.
